searchText: Great report <@944007601400741989> . If you have time I would be interested to find out how https://github.com/scroll-tech/reth-witness-indexer performs in similar benchmarks. Its an extended version of reth with a witness indexer similar to etherex. It may not be quite as efficient as etherex as this is done as a sort of post-execution hook but still interested to get some statistics. Alright, would look into this yeah, I suspect this also I can make changes to this, and I will probably refactor to introduce a new server type this week so we can remove the json rpc overhead. We just put together something that is MVP for the moment We should also speak with etherex team about introducing a new server type once we have done some experiments to see what works well. <@944007601400741989> do you write rust code? Yeah.. In the benchmark, I had Ethrex serve EngineAPI twice (JSON-RPC + TCP and JSON-RPC + IPC) so it is very plausible without technical overhead yeah, I do Would you be open to working on a feature to introduce a new server type in the `reth-witness-indexer` repo? I can write up an issue and add required context Sure, New server you mean serving over IPC rather than TCP right? I have not looked in this repo before, just to be sure Kinda of. Essentially replacing json rpc with something like grpc, raw HTTP or QUIC. Got you! would be happy to I guess the issue would hold any other technical detail I would need Correct. Anything that is unclear we can discuss and add to the issue. If you have time it would also be useful if you could contribute to the research phase as well. Essentially, exploring the pros and cons of different server implementations. Short list in my mind is gRPC, QUIC, raw HTTP, but if you could do a survey, that would also be great? sounds great. I would work in that direction Additionally, something that is related but somewhat orthogonal is compression, but we can defer this to a later stage. We may be able to optimise by compressing the payload to reduce size but we can leave this until later. So to summarise, I see the following action items: - <@944007601400741989> integrate pre-existing json rpc `reth-witness-indexer` in benchmarking framework and report - <@944007601400741989> survey server types and write up trade offs - Collabarative: decide on new server type - <@402080271563751435>: Write up issue on how to integrate chosen server type into `reth-witness-indexer` Yeah, I have been thinking in this direction also, but I guess it would all get do to numbers got after experimenting. https://eth-act.github.io/blob-encoding-experiments/ Kev did some compression benchmark I think you would find interesting, in some way this could be a start off point for experimenting same plans on execution witness Yes this sounds awesome!
